title: Composer photos: Inline chosen; free-placement Scrapbook deferred
context: The online Claude Design prototype offers two photo implementations in the composer: Inline (photos as blocks in the text flow with a contextual toolbar) and Scrapbook (photos on a free layer at page coordinates with drag, rotate and resize). The owner clarified that only one ships now, the other is deferred, and both are meant to share the same scrapbook feel.
options: Inline: photos anchored in the text flow, drawn with the scrapbook look
Scrapbook: photos at free page coordinates with drag, rotate and resize
outcome: Owner chose Inline ("Go with in-line"). Reasons: anchored photos survive reflow at every width (phone, full-width Today, day detail, composer); the existing storage, parser, reader, float, preview and search already treat a photo as a line of the note; R2 stays intact; phone and keyboard use work with taps; and free placement can be added later as a new placement type without migrating Inline notes, while the reverse would require converting positioned photos. The scrapbook feel (tape, tilt, white print border, handwritten caption) is applied to Inline photos as a visual style.
